name: Dr. Aafaq Mohi Ud Din
title: Assistant Professor, Department of CSE
tagline: Computer science, shown with real data.
bio: Dr. Aafaq Mohi Ud Din is an Assistant Professor (Rank 1, JKPSC State Cadre) in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at GCET Kashmir. He earned his PhD in Computer Science & Engineering from NIT Srinagar, working on geometric deep learning and graph neural networks, after an M.Tech and B.Tech from the University of Kashmir. He has taught Data Structures, Algorithms, Programming, Graph Theory, Compiler Design and Operating Systems at NIT Srinagar and GCET Kashmir, and has qualified GATE (CS & IT) seven times.

headline: I teach computer science the way I wish I had been taught: with real data, moving pictures, and answers you can check.
bio_story: I have qualified GATE seven times and UGC-NET five times. Somewhere along the way I noticed that students forget formulas, but they remember what they have seen. So every lecture I make starts from a real dataset and a picture, and every number on screen is computed and verified before it reaches you.

By day I teach in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at GCET Kashmir, where I joined as Assistant Professor after ranking first in the JKPSC selection. Before that I taught at NIT Srinagar.

My PhD at NIT Srinagar was on graph neural networks, and in particular on over-smoothing and over-squashing: the two reasons deep GNNs lose the information they are meant to pass along. That work, OOF-SAGE, and its follow-ups appear in journals with impact factors up to 13.6.
